title: Astr trailer tridem 3
objective: Create a three-slot, three-axle pneumatic drawbar trailer from the accepted Tandem-2 for astr_trailers, with adjustable height and independent front axle lift.

constraints: Do not alter accepted Tandem-2 or installed astr_trailers; no proxy geometry; source rights pending.
open_questions: User's intended placement/order of three axles and preferred form of third cargo slot.
Identify exact lift beam to match in material and color before texturing.

accepted_work.summary: Verified source copies, design and budget reports, Blender working scene with main-pin optimization only, and separate non-exportable rail geometry WIP. No Tridem XML, Editor test, game test, or release.

context.current_summary: User reviewed rail-only Blender preview and accepted exact rail extension as basis for upper longitudinal beam. Entire beam later gets a custom material/texture matching the identified lift beam. Blender GUI scene is open; 3 review renders saved. Three-slot bed, third axle and pneumatic suspension remain unmodeled.
decisions: Use current exact rail extension as starting profile for upper longitudinal beam; repair interfaces, caps, topology and UV before integration.
Create own material and texture for full beam after visually identifying lift-beam reference.
completed: Opened rail_extension_candidate.blend in visible Blender 5.2 window; confirmed process 31232 has main window.
Rendered verified side, top and three-quarter previews; source blend SHA-256 unchanged.
Updated tridem plan with user's new beam and material decision.
next_actions: Discuss the user's Tridem geometry ideas using current Blender view; then finalize axle and bed layout before modeling.
